goal: Freeze runtime capability metadata and provide one audited deployment-only catalog migration path.
acceptance: Every ordinary write under the common lock requires hash(runtime capabilities) == hash(current Git-default capabilities).
Apply, rollback, generic write, and constrained role Save also reject any candidate-to-runtime capability metadata delta under the same lock.
The deployment-only command is the only bypass and requires an active-superuser operator plus expected current-runtime and target-Git hashes, validation, backup, and audit record.
The command is unreachable from Settings Center and fails without changing files on any hash mismatch.
Ordinary role grant Save remains functional.
